name: Drake Friend
body:
Your bond with your drake has grown stronger.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Bond, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): Your legendary drake companion may possess up to 10 hit dice.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
